name: AI Product Content Generator & Automation Toolkit for WooCommerce (Bulk Generation) – AI Product Tools
author: Dogu Pekgoz

sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Visit the Toolkit Dashboard to choose your preferred bulk generation mode
  4. Choose your preferred AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini AI or OpenRouter)
  5. Enter and save your API key
  6. Customize your settings for your selected generator
  7. Start generating descriptions (single or bulk)
  8. Review and save your products
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

Yes! AI Product Tools offers extensive free functionality. The Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited and free – no credit system at all! For the Advanced Bulk Generator with premium SEO and other advanced features, you get 250 monthly credits free. You only need an API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter).

What’s new in the AI WooCommerce Toolkit Dashboard?

The new Toolkit Dashboard is your centralized control center for all AI tools! It features modern card-based interface where you can instantly compare tool capabilities, access quick settings, and manage your AI generators. This future-ready design seamlessly accommodates upcoming AI tools while giving you clear visibility of Standard vs Advanced features.

What’s the difference between Standard and Advanced Bulk Generators?

We offer two powerful generators to match your needs:

🏃‍♂️ Standard Bulk Generator (FREE):
– Unlimited usage – no credit limits ever
– Plain text output – clean, professional descriptions
– Basic SEO optimization – essential search benefits
– Multi-language support – generate in any language
– Simple workflow – one-click generation process

🚀 Advanced Bulk Generator (CREDIT-BASED):
– Advanced SEO-focused HTML output – rich formatting for better rankings
– AI Smart Parameters™ technology – automatic optimization for superior results
– Custom fields & variables support – precision targeting with {custom1}, {custom2}
– Edit before approve – perfect control over every description
– Generation history tracking – manage and track all content
– Improve existing content – enhance descriptions without starting over

How to use custom fields with AI Product Tools?

Custom fields integration is available exclusively in the Advanced Bulk Generator. Here’s how it works:

  1. Add variables to your prompts: Include placeholders like {custom1}, {custom2} in your Advanced Generator templates
  2. Map variables to your existing fields: In Advanced settings, connect each variable to a specific custom field
  3. Generate content: The AI will automatically use your custom field values in the content with AI Smart Parameters™ optimization

This powerful feature is perfect for highlighting specific product features like materials, specifications, benefits, or any other custom attributes you already track. Combined with our AI Smart Parameters™ technology, it creates truly unique, targeted content that perfectly showcases what makes each product special!

How does the credit system work?

The credit system applies only to the Advanced Bulk Generator. The Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited!

Advanced Bulk Generator Credits:
1. Credit Usage: Each generation (descriptions and tags) for a product uses 1 credit
2. Monthly Renewal: Credits automatically refresh every month
3. Plan Allocations:
– Free Users: 250 advanced bulk generation credits monthly
– Pro Users: 5,000 advanced bulk generation credits monthly
– Business Users: Unlimited advanced bulk generation credits

Important Notes:
– Standard Bulk Generator: Completely unlimited, no credits needed
– Advanced features require credits for quality optimization and advanced functionality
– Credits refresh automatically each month (unused credits don’t carry over)

Why do we use a credit system for Advanced Bulk Generation?

The credit system for the Advanced Bulk Generator only works hand-in-hand with our exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ technology to optimize both cost and quality. While the credit system helps manage advanced resources efficiently, our AI Smart Parameters™ technology automatically fine-tunes the AI models for each specific task – adjusting temperature, frequency penalties, and other technical parameters that would normally require expert knowledge. This dual optimization means you get exceptionally high-quality content that’s perfectly tailored to your products, while we maintain an efficient system for premium features. Remember: the Standard Bulk Generator is completely unlimited and free!

How does the AI Smart Parameters™ technology work?

Our exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ technology is only available in the Advanced Bulk Generator and is a game-changer that eliminates the complexity of configuring AI models. Here’s what makes it special:

  1. Automatic Optimization: The system intelligently configures temperature, top_p, frequency and presence penalties based on your content needs
  2. Model-Specific Tuning: Different settings are applied for OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter models, and even between specific models
  3. Content-Type Adaptation: Parameters are tailored differently for short descriptions, full descriptions, and tag generation
  4. Continuous Improvement: Our API regularly updates optimal parameters based on the latest AI model changes and content performance data

This advanced technology ensures you get superior results without being an AI expert. While other plugins and our Standard Generator use basic settings, the AI Smart Parameters™ technology in Advanced Generator ensures you get the highest quality content possible for each specific task!

What happens if I run out of Advanced AI Description Generator credits?

When you run out of Advanced Bulk Generator credits, you have several options:
1. Switch to Standard Generator – Use our unlimited Standard Bulk Generator anytime
2. Wait for monthly renewal – Advanced credits automatically refresh each month
3. Upgrade your plan – Pro (5,000 credits) or Business (unlimited credits)

How to choose the best AI provider for product descriptions?

Both OpenAI and Gemini AI deliver excellent results in both Standard and Advanced Generators:

OpenAI (ChatGPT) – All latest models including GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini
– Excels in creative writing and engaging content
– Great for storytelling and persuasive descriptions

Google Gemini AI – Gemini 2.5 Pro, Flash, and 2.0 Pro models
– Provides more structured, technical content
– Excellent for detailed product specifications

OpenRouter – Access to hundreds of AI models including FREE models
– Claude Sonnet 4, Grok 4, DeepSeek V3 (Free), Gemma 3n 2B (Free)
– Custom model addition and configuration
– Perfect for experimenting with different AI personalities

Try all three providers to find what works best for your products and preferred generator!

How to generate SEO-friendly product descriptions?

Yes! Both generators create SEO-optimized content:

Standard Bulk Generator:
– Basic SEO optimization with keywords and product attributes
– Clean, search-engine-friendly plain text descriptions

Advanced Bulk Generator:
– Advanced SEO-focused HTML output with rich formatting
– Enhanced optimization using AI Smart Parameters™ technology
– Structured content that search engines love

Both consider keywords, product attributes, and SEO best practices while maintaining readability and engagement.

How to customize AI-generated product descriptions?

Customization options vary by generator:

Both Standard & Advanced Generators:
– AI Provider selection (OpenAI, Gemini AI or OpenRouter)
– Language preferences (any language)
– Writing style selection
– Description length control
– Brand voice settings
– Product attributes integration

Advanced Bulk Generator Exclusive Features:
– Custom prompts with variables ({custom1}, {custom2})
– Custom fields integration for precision targeting
– Advanced bulk generation templates
– Edit before approve functionality
– HTML-enabled rich content

The custom fields feature in Advanced Generator is especially powerful – it lets you take any product-specific information (technical specs, materials, benefits, etc.) and tell AI to specifically highlight these details. This creates truly unique content that perfectly showcases what makes each product special!

Is my data secure?

Yes! We prioritize security above all else. Here’s what you should know about data handling in AI Product Tools:

What we DO collect:
– Basic site information (WordPress version, PHP version, plugin installation date etc.)
– Usage statistics to improve the plugin (frequency of usage, which features are most used)
– Plugin functioning data such as API response success/failure rates
– Your plan type (free, pro, business) for providing appropriate service levels
– If you’re using Freemius: site URL, admin email, and license information (for license verification only)

What we DON’T collect:
– Your OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter API keys (these are stored securely on your WordPress database only)
– Your product information (including categories, attributes, descriptions, prices, SKUs, etc.) – we never store any product data on our servers
– The full content of your product descriptions or generated content
– The prompts you use for content generation
– Customer data from your store

All data transmission is encrypted, and we implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. Your API keys and product data remain on your WordPress installation and are never stored on our servers.

For more detailed information about how we protect your data, please see our full Privacy Policy.

What makes AI Product Tools different from other AI description generators?

AI Product Tools revolutionizes content creation with our unique dual-generator approach:

🛠️ Complete AI WooCommerce Toolkit – Centralized dashboard with tool comparison and quick access
🚀 Revolutionary dual-generator system – Choose unlimited basic or advanced professional features
🤖 Latest AI technology – OpenAI ChatGPT (including GPT-4o, o1, o3), Google Gemini AI, Thousands OpenRouter models
🧠 Exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ – Automatic optimization technology
🎯 Custom fields integration – Precision targeting with variables
📝 Complete content solution – Descriptions, excerpts, and tags in one workflow
🔄 Content improvement technology – Enhance existing descriptions
💰 Cost optimization – Up to 40%+ API cost savings

Our focus on efficiency and scalability, combined with the choice between unlimited basic generation and advanced premium features, makes it perfect for both small shops and large WooCommerce stores.

How to improve existing product descriptions with AI?

Our innovative “Improve Descriptions” feature is available in the Advanced Bulk Generator only and allows you to enhance your existing product descriptions without starting from scratch. Simply select the products you want to improve, click the “Improve Existing Products” option in the toolbar, and watch as AI enhances your content while maintaining your original messaging. Perfect for refreshing your product catalog or improving underperforming listings!

How to keep parts of existing descriptions when generating new ones?

Yes! Both generators offer the “Keep Existing Descriptions” feature, but with different capabilities:

Standard Bulk Generator:
– Basic preservation of existing content
– Simple content enhancement

Advanced Bulk Generator:
– Advanced content preservation with AI-powered analysis
– Intelligent content improvement while maintaining brand voice
– Edit before approve for perfect control

This gives you the perfect balance between fresh content and maintaining your established brand voice in both generators!

What is OpenRouter integration and how does it work?

Our revolutionary OpenRouter integration opens up a world of AI possibilities! Here’s what makes it special:

Unlimited AI Models:
– Access to hundreds of cutting-edge AI models beyond OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter
– Many completely FREE models available at zero cost
– Custom model support for specialized needs

How It Works:
1. Connect your OpenRouter account (free to create)
2. Browse and select from hundreds of available models
3. Add custom models tailored to your specific requirements
4. Generate content using your chosen models

Benefits:
– No credit limitations with free models
– Experiment with different AI personalities
– Find the perfect model for your product content style
– Future-proof your content generation as new models become available

Perfect for businesses wanting maximum flexibility and cost control in their AI content generation!

How does AI Title Generation work?

Our AI Title Generation feature transforms how you create product titles:

Key Features:
– Bulk Title Generation – Create titles for thousands of products simultaneously
– Single Product Enhancement – Generate titles directly from product edit metabox
– SEO Optimization – Titles are crafted for maximum search engine visibility
– Brand Voice Adaptation – AI learns your style and maintains consistency

Premium Features (Pro & Business Plans):
– Advanced Tone Selection – Professional, casual, urgent, luxury, and specialized tones
– Generation Mode Control – Creative, balanced, or conservative approaches
– Keyword Targeting – Force specific keywords, brand names, or terms in every title
– Source Integration – Use custom data sources for ultra-personalized results

How It Works:
1. Select products for title generation (bulk or single)
2. Choose your tone and generation mode (Premium)
3. Set required keywords or brand terms (Premium)
4. AI analyzes product data, categories, and attributes
5. Generates compelling, SEO-optimized titles with your specifications
6. Review and approve titles before publishing

Perfect For:
– Refreshing existing product titles
– Creating consistent naming conventions with brand enforcement
– Improving SEO performance with targeted keywords
– Saving time on manual title creation
– Maintaining brand consistency across thousands of products

Available in both Standard and Advanced generators with enhanced premium features in Pro & Business plans!

How does the enhanced pagination work for large catalogs?

Managing large product catalogs is now effortless with our enhanced pagination system:

Custom Products Per Page:
– Choose exactly how many products to display (10, 25, 50, 100, or custom)
– Optimize your workflow based on your preferences
– Better performance with large catalogs

Advanced Page Navigation:
– Jump directly to any page number instantly
– No more endless clicking through pages
– Perfect for stores with thousands of products

Benefits:
– Faster navigation through massive product collections
– Customizable viewing experience
– Improved performance and loading times
– Better workflow management

Whether you have 100 or 10,000 products, our enhanced pagination ensures smooth and efficient catalog management!

sections.description:
AI Automation for WooCommerce: bulk-generate SEO titles, descriptions, tags & FAQs while you sleep with ChatGPT, Gemini & 100+ OpenRouter models!

🚀 Fully Automatic AI Content Automation Toolkit for WooCommerce

AI Product Tools is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that leverages artificial intelligence to revolutionize your product content workflow. With bulk description generation, intelligent title creation, smart tagging, and unlimited access to FREE AI models through OpenRouter integration, AI Product Tools eliminates manual writing while maximizing your store’s SEO impact and sales performance.

NEW: 🤖 AI Automation Jobs — Set It & Forget It Content Generation

Transform hours of manual work into automated workflows that run themselves:
– Work while you sleep: Schedule content generation for nights/weekends — wake up to hundreds of new descriptions
– Smart cost control: Optional auto-pause when credits run low — you stay in control of spending
– Stay productive: Keep working normally while AI generates content in the background — no more waiting or frozen admin
– Handle massive catalogs: Process thousands of products automatically with smart resuming if anything goes wrong
– Target exactly what you need: Filter by category, stock status, price ranges, attributes, and tags
– Enterprise-grade reliability: Robust state management with automatic resuming if anything goes wrong
– Use any AI provider: Seamlessly works with ChatGPT, Gemini, and OpenRouter models in one unified workflow
– Perfect for teams: Detailed activity logs show who generated what content and when — ideal for agencies
– Watch your progress: Real-time updates show exactly which products are being processed with accurate time estimates

⚡ Dual Bulk AI Product Content Generation System – Choose Your Power Level

Transform your product content creation with our revolutionary dual-generator approach that caters to every business need:

🏃‍♂️ Standard Bulk AI Product Content Generator – Perfect for Basic Needs

Unlimited usage with plain text output for clean, straightforward AI-generated product content.

🚀 Advanced Bulk AI Product Generator – Built for Growth-Focused Stores

Premium SEO-focused HTML output with advanced features like custom field integration, edit-before-approve functionality, content improvement capabilities, generation history, all attributes aware AI, auto optimization and our exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ technology for superior results.

🎯 Bulk AI Title Generation – Craft Perfect Product Names

Transform your product titles with our intelligent AI title generation system! Create compelling, SEO-optimized titles that capture attention and drive sales. Whether you need catchy marketing titles or professional product names, our AI adapts to your brand voice and industry requirements. Available in both bulk operations and individual product metabox for maximum flexibility.

Premium Title Generation Features (Pro & Business Plans):
– Advanced Tone Selection – Choose from professional, casual, urgent, luxury, and more specialized tones
– Generation Mode Options – Creative, balanced, or conservative approaches for different product types
– Keyword Targeting – Ensure specific keywords, brand names, or terms appear in every title
– Source Integration – Leverage custom data sources for ultra-personalized title generation

❓ AI Bulk FAQ Generator – Turn Products Into Instant Customer Support

Revolutionize your product pages with intelligent, AI-generated FAQs that answer customer questions before they’re even asked! Reduce support tickets, boost SEO rankings, and increase conversions by addressing buyer concerns proactively.

How It Works:
AI analyzes your product data—titles, descriptions, categories, attributes, and more—to generate relevant questions and comprehensive answers that your customers actually care about. Choose between plain text or rich HTML format, generate complete Q&A pairs or just questions/answers, and review each FAQ before publishing.

Key Benefits:
– Boost SEO – FAQ content is gold for search engines, improving product page rankings
– Reduce Support Load – Answer common questions automatically, saving time and resources
– Increase Conversions – Address buyer hesitations before they abandon their cart
– Bulk Processing – Generate FAQs for hundreds of products, approve individually or in bulk

🌟 OpenRouter Integration – Unlimited AI Models at Your Fingertips!

Break free from limitations! Connect with OpenRouter to access hundreds of cutting-edge AI models including completely FREE models. Add custom models tailored to your specific needs, experiment with different AI personalities, and find the perfect model for your product content. The future of AI is now in your hands – with zero cost for many powerful models!

🎯 Custom Fields Integration

Transform your existing custom field data into powerful AI variables:

How it works:
1. Insert variables like {custom1}, {custom2} in your prompts
2. Map each variable to your existing custom fields
3. AI automatically uses your field data for ultra-targeted descriptions

Example: Have a “material” field with “100% organic cotton”? Use it in prompts like: “Highlight that this product uses {custom1} material” – and AI creates content specifically about organic cotton!

🛠️ AI WooCommerce Toolkit Dashboard

This is your centralized control center that houses all AI tools for WooCommerce in one modern dashboard. It lets you:

✨ Your AI Toolkit for WooCommerce – As we continue adding new AI tools, your WooCommerce store evolves—powered by a smart AI command center built to be your right hand
✨ Quick-access tool settings – Jump directly to any tool’s configuration

🧠 Exclusive AI Smart Parameters™ Technology
